resources.string: Joins through the PC network module (Neon build), for servers without the mobile transport.
Joins through the PC network module (MTA build), for servers without the mobile transport.
This option runs MTA\'s PC netc.dll. Choose netc.dll from the MTA folder of a PC install, or download it from MTA.
This server needs the Neon build of netc.dll. Choose netc.dll from the MTA folder of a Neon PC install.
